# Azure Deploy — Safe Release Runner

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's deployment execution skill for applications that are already prepared: it runs `azd up`, `azd deploy`, `terraform apply` and `az deployment` through a strict pipeline — plan check, pre-deploy checklist, recipe loading, RBAC health check, execution with built-in error recovery, post-deploy configuration, and live verification with fully-qualified `https://` endpoint URLs reported back. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it REFUSES to run without a validated `.azure/deployment-plan.md` — prepare with azure-prepare and validate with azure-validate first, no shortcuts; deployments mutate live infrastructure, so destructive actions always require your explicit confirmation. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
